Step 2: Determine the total number of elements in set A.
The total number of elements in set A is found by adding 1 to each exponent in the prime factorization and multiplying them together. So, the total number of elements in set A is $(4+1)(2+1) = 15$.

The LCM of the elements in subset B must be 2025.

To form an LCM of 2025, the elements in subset B must include at least one 3 and one 5.
